verdict.rationale: Kick connects to banks and cards through Plaid (12,000+ institutions), syncs invoices from Stripe, Mercury and BILL and bills from Ramp/BILL in real time, and states that every transaction, including payroll runs, generates a journal entry that posts to the general ledger automatically. Synced transactions are then auto-categorized and rules run on sync. Missing for 10: no named payroll-provider integration (payroll is only referenced as a journal-entry source), payment-processor activity documented only as invoice sync rather than full payout/fee flows, no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Plaid: connects to 12,000+ banks and credit cards. The primary method for most accounts.
View invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL
View and manage your bills in Kick, with real-time sync from Ramp or BILL.
Every transaction in Kick - whether it came from your bank, a payroll run, or a bill - generates a journal entry that posts to your general ledger
Once a rule is created, it runs automatically every time a matching transaction syncs.
